label: Aqara Presence Sensor FP2 (mmWave)
description: Aqara Presence Sensor FP2 is a 60 GHz mmWave presence sensor that tracks up to five people, splits a room into zones and also reports lux and distance, exposed to Matter through an Aqara hub or natively over Wi-Fi. It is wireless-only with a 5 V USB-C power input: 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth 4.2 and no RJ45 jack - ceiling-mounted but not PoE-powered, whatever the install photos suggest.
